items.criterion: The readiness route answers 200 once the app is up.
items.evidence: A 200 from the readiness route on the public origin.

items.criterion: The public case list carries published cases newest first and omits drafts.
items.evidence: The project list payload, read as a top-level array.

items.criterion: A draft case detail route is denied to a signed-in reader.
items.evidence: The status of a reader request for the draft case detail route.

items.criterion: The hero object of a draft case is refused to a reader.
items.evidence: The status of a reader request for the draft hero through the streaming route.

items.criterion: Publishing a draft case makes its detail route and its hero readable.
items.evidence: The status of a visitor request for both surfaces after the publish.

items.criterion: Unpublishing a case denies its detail route and its hero again.
items.evidence: The status of a visitor request for both surfaces after the unpublish.

items.criterion: An uploaded hero is an object in the bucket under the declared key scheme.
items.evidence: The object listing under the case prefix, and the media row naming that key.

items.criterion: A complete enquiry submission stores exactly one enquiry row.
items.evidence: The enquiry row count before and after the submission.

items.criterion: An enquiry without the privacy consent is refused and writes nothing.
items.evidence: The refusal status and the unchanged enquiry row count.

items.criterion: Filtering the topic list by category returns only that category.
items.evidence: The category field of every row in the filtered payload.

items.criterion: A reader session is denied every editor-only endpoint.
items.evidence: The status of each reader request against the editor endpoints.

items.criterion: Open signup makes a reader account whatever role the request asks for.
items.evidence: The role stored on the account the signup created.

items.criterion: A mistyped path answers with a genuine not-found status.
items.evidence: The status of a request for a path that matches no route.

items.criterion: No backing-service credential reaches the browser in a served document.
items.evidence: The served home document, scanned for the seeded credential values.

items.criterion: The coloured mass reads as one continuous lobed body rather than overlapping circles.
items.evidence: A neck where two lobes meet, and no visible intersection anywhere.

items.criterion: Text arrives line by line with the fade finishing before the movement.
items.evidence: A line reveal whose opacity settles noticeably ahead of its transform.

items.criterion: The settings panel grows from its control and softens the page behind it.
items.evidence: The panel's arrival, and the blur appearing with the growth.

items.criterion: The settings panel is operable from the keyboard alone and returns focus on close.
items.evidence: A keyboard-only pass over the nine controls, and focus after Escape.
